brand.name: Verdan
brand.one_line_description: An everyday cooking oil, cold-pressed from hemp seed, made to bring plant-based Omega 3 and 6 into the kitchens people already cook in.
brand.mission: To make one plant-based swap — the cooking oil in your pantry — an easy, everyday source of good fats, without asking anyone to change how they cook.
brand.vision: In five years, Verdan is the oil families reach for the same way they reach for olive oil, because it's simply what's in the cupboard.
core_values: Better tomorrow, one small swap at a time
brand.positioning_statement: For home cooks who already care what's in their pantry, Verdan is the cold-pressed hempseed oil that brings plant-based Omega 3 and 6 into everyday cooking, because good nutrition should fit into the meals you already make.
competitors: Filippo Berio and other mainstream olive oils
brand.differentiation: A hemp seed oil sold and priced as an everyday cooking oil rather than a specialty wellness product, with a straightforward grocery-shelf label that leads with nutrition — Omega 3 and 6 — rather than ritual or lifestyle.

product.name: Verdan Cold Pressed Hempseed Oil
product.description: A 500mL bottle of cold-pressed hempseed cooking oil, unrefined and plant-based, rich in Omega 3 and Omega 6, sized for regular use rather than occasional drizzling.
key_features: Cold-pressed hempseed oil, unrefined and plant-based
Rich in Omega 3 and Omega 6 fatty acids
500mL bottle sized for everyday kitchen use
Clear, grocery-aisle labeling: what it is, what it's rich in, where it fits
top_benefits: An easy way to add plant-based Omega 3 and 6 to meals you're already cooking
A nutty, green flavor that works in dressings, drizzles, and finishing dishes
One bottle that covers what a fish-oil supplement does for some households
product.proof_points: Cold-pressed within 24 hours of milling to preserve fatty-acid content; Omega 3:6 ratio independently tested and printed on every batch; sourced from a single hemp cooperative with full crop traceability.
product.category: Most households default to olive or sunflower oil for everyday cooking and treat specialty oils like flax or hemp as occasional purchases rather than pantry staples.

audience.primary_audience: Home cooks and parents, 30-55, who plan meals for a household and read nutrition labels while grocery shopping.
audience.demographics: Suburban and small-city households, middle income, shop at mainstream grocery chains and natural food aisles, cook most meals at home.
audience.psychographics: Cares about nutrition but doesn't have time for a wellness routine; wants small, sustainable swaps rather than a full diet overhaul; trusts a label that explains itself over one that relies on branding.
pain_points: Wants more Omega-3s in the family diet but finds fish-oil supplements a hassle to keep everyone taking
Assumes 'hemp' oil is expensive, complicated, or connected to cannabis
Doesn't know how a specialty oil fits into everyday cooking, not just salads
audience.desired_outcome: Feeling like they've made one easy, lasting improvement to how the family eats, without overhauling the pantry or the budget.
channels: Grocery store shelf and end-cap placement
audience.objections: Price is higher than a bottle of standard vegetable oil; uncertainty about cooking temperature and smoke point; confusion with CBD or cannabis products.
audience.secondary_audience: Nutrition-focused school and workplace cafeterias looking for an easy plant-based oil swap in bulk.

we_are: Plain about what's in the bottle and where it fits in a normal week of cooking
Focused on small, doable changes, not lifestyle overhauls
Written like a trusted family grocery brand, not a supplement company
we_are_not: Making detox, cure, or miracle claims
Talking about cannabis, CBD, or 'highs' in any form
Positioning this as a luxury or once-in-a-while treat
tone.example_line: Same pantry, same recipes. Just swap the oil.

offer.core_offer: Buy one 500mL bottle, get a recipe card set with 10 everyday ways to use it.
offer.pricing_packaging: $12.99 per 500mL bottle; a 2-pack at $22 for regular households; available in single bottles and multi-packs at partner grocers.
offer.urgency_reason: The recipe card set is included only with the first production run.
offer.guarantee: Money back if it hasn't become part of your regular cooking rotation within 30 days.
offer.post_conversion: Welcome email sends the full recipe set, storage tips, and a simple explanation of Omega 3 versus Omega 6 and why both matter.
